description: Lorenly Booking helps people discover beauty and wellness businesses, browse current services and prices, check live appointment availability, review deposit and intake requirements, and place a guarded appointment hold. Free appointments require confirmation through an emailed link, while deposit appointments are completed on Lorenly's secure external checkout page; card details are never collected in ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: What businesses can I book with Lorenly?
Show me the services and prices for a business
Find an available appointment in beauty and wellness and help me book
